Each zone is one party that acts.
A pill names what passes from one
zone to the next.
ourapps keeps the library, the catalogue
and the share links. The building happens
in your repository, on your computer.
You and your agent
Evaluation: the recipe and your answers make a design
aepm: assembles the design on your computer

g.text: you or your agent read what
lists; run none of their code

svg.text: Delivery: your accounts, your people
